sourceProfile.drawing_scope: InvConv2dLU only; initialization is state provenance, not a repeated forward QR/LU.

sourceFacts: The 1x1 weight is square and mixes channels at each pixel; determinant scales by H*W.
LU source learns strict-triangular factors and log absolute diagonal; permutation, masks, signs and identity are buffers.
Reverse uses an explicit matrix inverse, outside the selected forward view.
